[quote=etherniasti;58776998][b]Official Diplomatic Request from the Government of Etherniasti [/b]

To: The Esteemed Government of [nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation]

Subject: Proposal for Mutual Visa-Free Access Agreement

Date: March 13, 2025

On behalf of the Government of Etherniasti and under the direct guidance of our honored Leader, Reginold the 3rd, we extend warm greetings to the Government and the people of the Lavinsworth United Islands. 

Recognizing the longstanding friendly relations, mutual respect, and shared values between our two nations, Etherniasti wishes to formally propose an agreement establishing mutual visa-free travel. This initiative aims to strengthen cultural exchange, enhance economic cooperation, and further deepen the bonds of friendship between our citizens.

Etherniasti strongly believes that such an arrangement will greatly benefit both nations by facilitating tourism, business exchanges, and fostering closer interpersonal relationships.

We kindly request that your esteemed government considers this proposal, and we eagerly await your favorable response. Representatives of our government stand ready to meet at your convenience to discuss this proposal in greater detail and formalize this mutually beneficial agreement.

With sincere respect and anticipation,

Commander Alaric Trevayne
Minister of Foreign Affairs
Government of Etherniasti[/quote]

The Lavian government openly welcomes this deal. Allies are much needed in the modern world, and there is no opposition to such proposal. While IDs will still be needed at airports and ports, visas will be negated. 

Signed:
- Wallace H. Achebe
- Herman Lavinsworth III
- Ivanka Roise

[b]Operation Spyglass - Mission #011[/b]
On the morning of March 13th, The Army high command gave the order for Mission 11 to begin. The day before, the parliamentary assembly had had a lengthy debate over whether this mission was too risky or not. The result was controversial, with a narrow vote allowing the mission to take place, with some restrictions. Mission 11 involves a small group of cobra team soldiers being deployed into a large Sal-Baliz controlled city. There objective is to assess the quality of life there and determine how urgently its residents need help. It was ruled by the assembly that these operatives should not engage in any unnecessary combat and that they should not try to seek out confidential Sal-Baliz information as this would be too risky. 

At 4:50pm, a helicopter dropped the operatives off in the desert, around 10 miles from Sal-Baliz territory. Any closer and they would have been detected. At 7:25pm they arrived by foot at a Sal-Baliz outpost. Armed guards were sent to greet them. Identification, ordered a soldier, whilst pointing an AK-74 at them. The Cobra team officers had been provided with fake identification. Welcome back my brothers! shouted the soldier whilst chuckling. After a brief moment of laughter, the operatives were shown to a transport that took them to the city, known as Jinarat. The Hydronian Military has ordered them not to communicate with them as it is deemed to risky, so the government is currently unaware of their mission progress.

[b]Patrol Vessel "Sea Hawk" - Etherniasti Naval Patrol - March 13, 2025[/b]

Under the quiet starlight, the EHS Sea Hawk navigated the calm yet vigilant waters near United Hydronia. The patrol boat, tasked with routine maritime security, quietly skimmed through the waves, unaware of any unusual circumstances until the ships communications officer, Petty Officer Lucan, suddenly held up a hand sharply, signaling silence.

"Commander Tarris," Lucan urgently whispered, "Im intercepting encrypted radio communications. The frequency matches known Sal-Baliz channels."

Commander Jorin Tarris, an experienced yet cautious naval officer, approached swiftly, his brow furrowed. "Decrypt it immediately."

Lucan adjusted his equipment and moments later, the transmission crackled clearly through their radio:

"Attention all units, command is issuing high alert status. Earlier reports confirm sighting of unidentified helicopter near our border. Units in the vicinity of Jinarat have been dispatched for investigation. Maintain heightened vigilance and report any suspicious activities immediately. Allah watch over us. Over."

The crew exchanged tense glances. Commander Tarris stood rigid, fully comprehending the gravity of this intercepted communication.

"Record and secure this transmission," Commander Tarris instructed firmly, "we must inform Port Thriump without delay. Maintain radio silence; any transmission might expose our position."

As the EHS Sea Hawk continued silently through the night, the crew felt the heavy responsibility of possessing critical intelligence. Etherniasti's patrol had unexpectedly unveiled the alertness and suspicions of Sal-Baliz commandinformation that could significantly influence diplomatic and security responses across the region.

What is it? He demanded.
I believe its a helicopter sir, but its too far away to be certain. Replied the soldier.
Can you identify where it came from?
No sir.
The Commander growled and stormed off into a communications room.
Give me that! He said as he snatched a microphone from someone.
Is this Supreme leader Madhi? He enquired into the microphone.
What do you want? Replied a gruff voice from the other end.
A suspicious helicopter has been spotted approximately 10 miles from our current northern border, said the commander.
I see, why do I need to know this?
Well I thought you might want to dispatch some troops si-

Yes sir, replied the startled commander. Notify all of our units about the situation and dispatch a team to Jinarat.
